text:
mira (AE): Heads-up: large enterprise wants a POC but with an unusual constraintthey require a strict US-only data path for inference, logs, metrics, and key material. No EU/APAC subprocessors, and no model weight pulls from non-US storage during scale-up. Customer asked: feasible on Hosted? impact on price/timeline?

devin (SE): Feasible but with caveats. We have tenant-scoped routing + region affinity already. The tricky bits are: 1) third-party telemetry (some integrations default to multi-region endpoints), 2) model artifact storage/replication (autoscaling may pull from model store endpoints), 3) edge accelerators/CDN logs. Need ops + infra signoff.

ops-anya: Quick ops note: we can create a tenant "geo_lock" profile that denies non-US placement and disables non-US integrations. Steps: validation run vs subproc inventory, disable telemetry hooks for tenant, create US-only artifact access role. Estimate 4 business days to validate and create a canary policy.

sec-lex: Legal/security: If they demand that keys and logs never leave the US, we must use tenant-scoped KMS keys in US regions and ensure no cross-region replication or backup to non-US. Also need confirmation on whether anonymized telemetry is acceptable. If they require absolute proof, we'll need a bespoke subprocessor addendum + attestation. That usually adds 7-10 business days.

infra-max: Model weight note: our model store normally replicates weights to nearest available region for faster cold-starts. For this POC we can pin model artifacts to US buckets only and block replication for the tenant. That increases cold start time slightly for traffic originating from APAC (but the customer is okay with that). Also, there might be higher egress costs when forcing traffic into specific regions. Rough cost uplift: ~10-18% on per-request cost depending on traffic pattern.

mira (AE): They also asked whether our CDN/edge logging provider stores logs outside US. Who owns that check?

ops-anya: Ops will run a full subproc check (CDN, monitoring, traced vendors). If any provider stores logs outside US we can either: 1) disable that integration for the tenant, or 2) request a contractual restriction/POC mode from vendor. Option 1 is faster but removes some observability features.

devin (SE): Example tenant config we can show them (poC-ready):

```
tenant: corp-zenith
geo_lock: US_ONLY
routing:
  allowed_regions: [us-east1, us-west1]
  disallowed_regions: [europe-west1, asia-east1, asia-south1]
model_artifacts:
  storage_policy: US_ONLY
integrations:
  telemetry: disabled_for_tenant
  cdn_logging: disabled_if_non_us
kms:
  keys: [us-east1:tenant-key]
```

This illustrates the main knobs.

sec-lex: Also note: if they require that 3rd-party subprocessors be removed from the "managed subprocessor" list for this tenant, we must confirm whether any of our partners (e.g., analytics vendor B) have US-only deployment options. If not, we can't guarantee removal without replacing the vendor or turning off the integration.

mira (AE): Timeline + SOW language they requested for the pre-sale: short bullet list for the contract + a PS estimate for validation time. Can someone draft the bullets and a conservative timeline?

ops-anya: Draft timeline: 1) 2 business days - subprocessor inventory + initial feasibility, 2) 3 business days - ops validation & tenant policy creation, 3) 2 business days - canary + smoke tests, 4) 5-10 business days - legal subprocessor amendment (if required). Total: 7-17 biz days depending on legal.

infra-max: Pricing note for SOW: recommend line item "Geo-locking surcharge (tenant-level) estimated +12% unit cost" and a PS estimate for validation (5 days @ engineering rate).

devin (SE): I'll assemble a 1-pager tech summary (config snippet, limitations, monitoring tradeoffs) by EOD. Ops-anya will attach runbook checklist. Sec-lex can draft contract bulletry.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary branch created: refs/geo-lock/2956789012-us-only-poc. CI pipeline started. :rocket:

mira (AE): Awesome. I'll update customer with the draft timeline and the config snippet now. Please tag me once the 1-pager is ready. :thumbsup:
